content.text: Cost of livingSecurityHealthWhere to surf in El SalvadorEl Salvador has gone through a tumultuous time with civil war followed by economic devastation and violent social unrest. Things have improved dramatically and more surfers are discovering this fascinating country is drenched in quality waves in two distinct regions.West El SalvadorThe far western coastline of El Salvador resembles Guatemala with straight unbroken beaches, except for the large rivermouth (la bocana) at Barra de Santiago. Acajutla faces due west and picks up smaller windswells, but the port and petroleum plant pollution is heavy. The Costa del Balsamo provides the lion’s share of the righthand pointbreaks stretching from as far west as Mizata back along the impossibly twisty, coastal mountain range road that allows glimpses of perfect regular foot set-ups like K59 and 61, before hitting the crowded line-ups of Zunzal and Punta Roca, touted as one of the best righthand points on the planet. East El SalvadorBeyond La Libertad lies 120km of thumping beachbreak interrupted by many large rivermouths draining the muddy coastal estuarine wetlands. Check the playas at El Pimental, Costa del Sol and El Zapote.The right points begin again in the The Oriente Salvaje which has forged a reputation for great waves suiting all abilities.El Salvador surf mapExplore the 2 regions & 20 surf breaks in El Salvador.Costa del BalsamojfmamjjasondPositivesPerfect right pointbreaksMellow warm wavesGood wind patternsCheap livingNegativesRarely bigFew winter swellsRainy swell seasonThefts and questionable securityUse two fingers to move the mapUse ctrl + scroll to zoom the mapTravel InformationGeneralTourists1,677,300Population6,486,205Tourist InfoTourist InfoSecurityHealthMoneyCurrencySVCExchange rate$1 = $1 USD SVCCost of livingCommunicationDialing in+503Dialing out00Emergencies911LanguageSpanish, NahuaElectricityVisasMost nationalities can visit visa free for stays of up to 90 days.Due to global pandemic, Visas, Getting There, Getting Around or Accommodation information and pricing may have changed.
